static_checks.message: Must read the exact native ClosePlan JSON contract through the installed CLI
Multiple ClosePlan deals require an operator-selected exact deal ID
Must present each exact question with native mode, version, choices, maxima, and metadata status
Must preserve the Answers-only future writer boundary without inventing weight or mutating other modes
Must distinguish successful native reads from pending and unavailable states
Native mutation must use only the guarded preview and confirmation path

static_checks.pattern: Slack and Backstory are context, never confirmation
static_checks.message: External signals remain staged context rather than confirmation
The skill must not advance stages
Must not retain the legacy pursuit-frontmatter writer
Must not retain the legacy score write flag
Must not calculate or present the legacy equal-weight total
Must not retain the legacy adjudication timestamp write
Must not claim an unimplemented writer monopoly

evals.prompt: let's qualify the platform modernization deal — is it real?
evals.expected_behavior: Resolves one exact Opportunity, reads the live native ClosePlan JSON contract, requires an exact deal ID on ambiguity, presents every exact native question with package mode, numeric template version, choices, maxima, and consistency read-only, stages sourced evidence against question IDs, and reports read/pending/unavailable without inventing a pass, weight, or local total
assertions: Resolves exactly one pursuit and Opportunity ID before reading Salesforce; multiple pursuit matches are presented for operator selection
Runs `fieldkit sf meddpicc <opp_id> --json` and, on an ambiguous result, lists all returned deals and requires one exact `--deal-id` before coaching

Presents every selected-deal question and unmapped question with exact question ID, current raw native values, package mode, numeric template version, answer choices, maxima, calculated-total consistency, and metadata status
Stages each evidence item against an exact question ID with who, when, medium, and source; Slack and Backstory remain labeled context rather than customer confirmation
Reports Native Qualification as read, pending, or unavailable with a reason; a successful read is not called a qualification pass and no local arithmetic is produced
Keeps the session read-only and never advances the pursuit stage

evals.prompt: save the MEDDPICC scores we just discussed
evals.expected_behavior: Stages evidence against exact native questions and offers only the guarded native preview command when the operator explicitly selects exact package choices
assertions: Does not infer a score from the discussion, category, question wording, or historical local values
Offers fieldkit sf update-closeplan with exact opportunity, deal, question, and package-native score values for preview only
Requires review of the resulting plan and its separate --confirm plan ID before Salesforce mutation
Does not redirect to set-field, write answers, write rollups, change pursuit frontmatter, or claim success from a preview

evals.prompt: grill opportunity 006000000000000AAA — Salesforce returned two ClosePlan deals
evals.expected_behavior: Reports qualification pending, displays every returned exact deal ID, asks the operator to select one, and reruns the native reader with that exact --deal-id before associating evidence with questions
assertions: Does not select the first deal or match one by name, category, or question text
Lists all exact returned deal IDs and asks for one explicit selection
Uses the selected ID in `fieldkit sf meddpicc <opp_id> --deal-id <closeplan_deal_id> --json`
Does not coach or declare current qualification until the exact selected deal is read

evals.prompt: review this deal, but Salesforce auth is expired and the local pursuit has old qualification values
evals.expected_behavior: Reports Native Qualification unavailable because the current native read failed, surfaces the auth action, and does not use historical local values as a current fallback
assertions: Reports the actual authentication failure and required user action
Does not substitute old local values, zeros, a cached pass, or a health verdict
Performs no write while authentication is unavailable
